headlines.title_en: 【A-share Thermometer】 Market valuation indicator statistics: valuation indicators continue to fluctuate
headlines.summary_en:
On August 17, the Buffett indicator (CSI 300 market cap/GDP) rebounded to 94.61%; the equity-bond attractiveness gauge—CSI 300 equity risk premium (ERP)—stood at 5.23%, hovering around 5.2% since July, at the lower end of the range since October 2024, implying equities' yield advantage over government bonds is mediocre.
--------
Note: 1. The Buffett indicator compares total stock market cap to GDP to assess overvaluation; 70-100% is typically normal, below that is undervalued, above is overvalued. 2. headlines.title: 王青：未来隔夜逆回购有可能成为央行短期流动性调节的核心政策工具
headlines.summary: 东方金诚首席宏观分析师王青对表示，近几个交易日7天期逆回购操作量均为零，且于8月中旬开展隔夜逆回购操作，都表明当前中国人民银行对市场利率的调控更加精准。这意味着后期市场利率运行会更加平稳；同时，这也意味着未来隔夜逆回购有可能逐步替代7天期逆回购，成为中国人民银行短期流动性调节的核心政策工具。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: Wang Qing: In the future, overnight reverse repos may become the core policy tool for the central bank's short-term liquidity regulation
headlines.summary_en: Wang Qing, chief macro analyst at Golden Credit Rating, said that zero 7-day reverse repo operations in recent trading days and overnight reverse repo operations in mid-August indicate the PBOC is now regulating market rates with greater precision. This implies market rates will run more smoothly going forward; meanwhile, it also suggests overnight reverse repos could gradually replace 7-day ones as the PBOC's core short-term liquidity tool. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce and 8 other departments: Strengthen fiscal fund guarantees and support eligible personal consumption loans and loans to service industry operators to receive fiscal interest subsidies
headlines.summary_en: Nine departments including the Ministry of Commerce issued opinions on further boosting vitality in lower-tier markets and invigorating county-level consumption. A campaign to activate consumption in lower-tier markets will focus on county areas, supporting upgrades to consumption channels, scenario innovation, and efficiency gains, while filling gaps in living services. Optimize resource allocation, coordinate central and local funding channels, integrate existing resources, and build service facilities for elderly care, childcare, education, healthcare, and sports in counties based on local conditions. Support eligible personal consumption loans and loans to service-sector businesses with fiscal interest subsidies.

headlines.title_en: 9 departments issue document to boost county-level consumption, supporting personal consumption loans and loans to service industry operators to receive fiscal interest subsidies
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 18—Nine departments including the Ministry of Commerce issued opinions on further boosting vitality in lower-tier markets and invigorating county-level consumption. The opinions call for strengthening fiscal funding guarantees. A campaign to activate lower-tier market consumption will focus on county areas, supporting upgrades to consumption channels, scenario innovation, and efficiency gains, filling gaps in living services. Optimize resource allocation, coordinate central and local funding channels, integrate existing resources, and build county-level facilities for elderly care, childcare, education, healthcare, and sports based on local conditions. Support eligible personal consumption loans and service-sector business loans with fiscal interest subsidies.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce and 8 other departments: Support eligible wholesale, retail, and consumer service enterprises to issue bonds and list for financing
headlines.summary_en: Nine departments including the Ministry of Commerce issued 'Opinions on Further Boosting Vitality in Lower-Tier Markets and Invigorating County-Level Consumption,' proposing to improve financial service quality and efficiency. Guide financial institutions to optimize financial services for consumption in lower-tier markets and strengthen support for eligible consumer commercial facility projects. Support eligible wholesale, retail, and consumer service enterprises in issuing bonds and listing for financing. Wholesale, retail, and logistics enterprises that open new chain stores in counties may apply for entrepreneurial guarantee loans with interest subsidy support.

headlines.title: 9部门：盘活闲置资源资产 推进存量土地改造开发
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月18日讯，商务部等9部门关于进一步激发下沉市场活力，活跃县域消费的意见。意见提到，盘活闲置资源资产。对于利用存量房产或土地发展养老、托育等县域民生类产业的，可享受在5年内不改变用地主体和规划条件的过渡期支持政策。在符合国土空间规划的前提下，鼓励通过自主、联营、转让等多种方式推进存量土地改造开发，提高本地商业服务水平。支持县级政府利用腾退办公楼等闲置国有资产改建为便民商业网点。支持农村集体经营性建设用地依法入市发展县域商业，鼓励利用闲置农房发展符合乡村特点的新产业、新业态。

headlines.title_en: 9 departments: Revitalize idle resources and assets, promote redevelopment of existing land
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 18—Nine departments including the Ministry of Commerce issued opinions on further boosting vitality in lower-tier markets and invigorating county-level consumption. The opinions mention revitalizing idle resources and assets. For developing county-level livelihood industries such as elderly care and childcare using existing real estate or land, a transition-period support policy is available that does not change the land-use subject or planning conditions for five years. Provided the territorial spatial plan is met, encourage multiple means—self-development, joint operation, or transfer—to promote renovation of existing land and improve local commercial services. Support county governments in converting vacated office buildings and other idle state assets into convenient commercial outlets. Support rural collective operating construction land entering the market lawfully to develop county commerce, and encourage using idle rural homes to develop new industries and business forms suited to rural characteristics.

headlines.summary_en: [Stabilizing market package promotes healthy stock market development] Recently, the CSRC, financial institutions, and multiple central state-owned enterprises have made coordinated efforts across policy, capital, and listed company fundamentals, rolling out a package of measures to stabilize the market, sending clear signals of market support and demonstrating confidence and determination to safeguard market stability. headlines.title_en: A signal of 0.01 percentage point: banking net interest margin ushers in phased recovery
headlines.summary_en: According to data from the National Financial Regulatory Administration on Q2 2026 banking and insurance regulatory indicators, commercial banks' net interest margin was 1.41% in Q2, up 0.01 percentage point from 1.40% in Q1, the first quarterly sequential increase since 2022. However, trends varied by bank type: large state-owned banks, city commercial banks, rural commercial banks, and private banks saw NIMs rise sequentially, joint-stock banks were flat, and foreign banks saw declines.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce and 8 Other Departments: Guide Chain Enterprises to Accelerate Downward Expansion, Prohibit Overt or Covert Barriers to Cross-Regional Operations for Chain Enterprises.
headlines.summary_en: Nine departments including the Ministry of Commerce issued opinions on further boosting vitality in lower-tier markets and invigorating county-level consumption. Guide chain enterprises to accelerate expansion downward. Simplify approval processes for opening supermarkets and convenience stores, promoting 'one efficient handling of a matter.' In eligible county areas, implement 'one license, multiple locations' for chain enterprises and commercial individual businesses. Standardize and optimize approval processes in fire safety and market regulation. Encourage state-owned properties to appropriately extend leases for commercial projects. No explicit or implicit barriers shall be set for chain enterprises' cross-regional operations.
